prompt.project_info: Create a clean Scandinavian-style casual portrait of an approved adult platinum-blonde woman seated on white indoor stairs in soft daylight.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair, calm confident expression, natural makeup, and one hand touching her face. She wears a beige fitted T-shirt with the existing 'Paris' script when the text reference is intentionally retained, black-and-white plaid pants, and a casual elegant styling.
prompt.composition_elements: Slightly low-angle portrait from the stairs, white bookshelves and geometric stair rails behind, large window at left, seated relaxed pose, plaid pants clearly visible, and 'Paris' shirt typography legible only when explicitly requested.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural window daylight, gentle shadows, neutral-warm clean Scandinavian interior, calm editorial lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: DSLR-style 35mm lens, f/2.8, high-resolution photorealism, shallow depth of field, sharp face, natural skin texture, accurate hands, subtle grain.
